outline:
課程內容涵蓋機械振動與噪音、聲學基礎、聲波傳播、聲音之反射與折射、聲學量測、振動抑制與隔離技術、噪音降低與吸音材料、消音器與噪音控制，以及相關法規與環境議題。
Topics include: Mechanical vibration and noise, Fundamentals of acoustics, Sound wave propagation, Reflection and refraction of sound, Acoustic measurement, The use of vibration isolators and absorbers, Noise reduction and sound-absorbing materials, Silencers and noise control, Noise regulations, and environmental considerations.

notes:
Flexible Learning:
1. Category:
Student group practice and discussion
2. Content:
Week 17: Each student group conducts practice and discussion on a noise prediction problem and completes the analysis according to the given conditions.
Week 18: Each group presents the results of the Week 17 practice, followed by class Q&A and discussion.
3. Hours:
Total: 6 hours.
4. Learning outcomes:
Students apply the learned methods in noise prediction to case analysis, result organization, and oral presentation.
5. Subject mark:
Weeks 17–18 class report and performance: 15%
